verdict.rationale: Drata's public API v2 documents 'Create Custom Framework' and 'Create Framework Requirements' endpoints. It also documents 'Create Control' with requirement mappings, plus Evidence Library item creation and versioning, so custom frameworks, controls and evidence sit alongside built-in ones. Custom Connections feed custom evidence into the platform, and Monitoring Tests can be listed and updated. missing for 10: an explicit endpoint or doc for authoring your own new monitoring tests (only list/update is shown), help-center walkthroughs of the custom framework/control workflow beyond API endpoint titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.
